ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a food web. In the lower middle there is a node labeled "detritus", and in the lower middle position there is a node labeled "freshwater shrimp". A purple arrow can be seen pointing from "detritus" to "freshwater shrimp". In a food web, arrows usually indicate that food or energy flows from a food source to a consumer. Therefore, if detritus decreases, the food source available to freshwater shrimp will also decrease, which may cause the number of freshwater shrimp to decline.
